description: Star Harvest opens the site arcade: a 90-second canvas run that gathers stars, dodges rocks and chains quick pickups into a combo, with the games index listing it first.
lead: The journal grows a small arcade. Star Harvest is a 90-second canvas run with a combo multiplier, three lives and a persistent best score, and the new games index lists it with a note that more games are coming. Everything is vanilla script and tokens, with hashed same-origin assets and no network calls.
merge_note: Pre-merge: this entry ships in the same change per the standing rule; the merge identifier is recorded after the gate passes on the exact head.

The full suite, the rebuild and the presence gate run green before review, with contrast and weight budgets sampled and reported.

title: Star Harvest opens the arcade
